message.content:
The **C♯ major** scale consists of the following notes:

| Scale Degree | Note |
|--------------|------|
| 1 (tonic)    | C♯ |
| 2 (supertonic) | D♯ |
| 3 (mediant) | E♯ (enharmonically F) |
| 4 (subdominant) | F♯ |
| 5 (dominant) | G♯ |
| 6 (submediant) | A♯ |
| 7 (leading tone) | B♯ (enharmonically C) |
| 8 (octave) | C♯ |

So the full C♯ major scale is:

**C♯ – D♯ – E♯ – F♯ – G♯ – A♯ – B♯ – C♯**

It has a key signature of seven sharps.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the musical scale associated with C sharp major?" They want the notes of the C# major scale. We can answer: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. But E# is enharmonic to F, B# to C. So the scale: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. Or we could mention the key signature: 7 sharps. Provide the scale. No function needed.
